decisions.statement: An access token within a minute of expiring is refreshed.
A summary has only the seven headers the mailbox asks Gmail for.
A history id Gmail no longer has answers as nothing rather than as a fault.
An unanswered history id is followed by a listing of the whole inbox.
Bytes are sent unchanged rather than built from a composition.
This mailbox and `gmail-client` are the same Gmail client.
Raw message bytes and a raw send are reached through `gmail-messages`.

definition: the Gmail mailbox reached over HTTP as summaries, raw bytes and labels
